name: The Gem Theatre
online_fee: $1 per ticket for online advance tickets
good_to_know: Kids under 2 sitting on an adult's lap don't need a ticket.
Children 15 and under must be with an adult (18+) at all times.
R-rated films: guests 16 and under need a guardian 21+ for the whole show. Bring ID.
Online ticket? Bring the card you paid with, or the confirmation on your phone or printed.
Movies and times can change: check the ticket page or call 704-932-5111.
accessibility: Wheelchair access and infrared assistive listening devices are available. Ask at least 24 hours ahead: 704-932-5126 or gem@kannapolisnc.gov.
parking: Free public parking downtown (Laureate Way, West Avenue, City Hall and nearby lots); drop-off and pick-up at the Gem on Laureate Way. A free West Avenue Express shuttle runs 5–10 p.m. Friday–Sunday, April–December.

support.text: Sponsor a marquee sidewalk brick or a seat in the auditorium.

films.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
films.description: Revisit the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.

films.title: Hexed
films.description: An awkward teen and her Type-A mother learn her peculiarities might be magical powers, transforming their lives and revealing a hidden magical realm.

films.title: Avengers: Doomsday
films.description: Heroes from three different worlds must unite when they're thrust together to confront a catastrophic danger that could destroy everything they know.
films.note: Avengers Doomsday contains several sequences with flashing lights that may affect those who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy or have other photosensitivities.

films.title: Christmas Movie Matinees
films.description: Enjoy some Christmas movie favorites this holiday season at The Gem Theatre! 12 p.m. Dec. 21 - Dr. Seuss' How the Grinch Stole Christmas 12 p.m. Dec. 22 - The Polar Express 12 p.m. Dec. 23 - Elf
